DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/email/send.description: Deletes an email suppression for the specified account.
Deletes the suppression, its note, and every legacy internal zone membership, allowing future delivery attempts to the address.
DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/email/send.x-forge-require-confirmation: This operation removes an Email Sending suppression and may allow email delivery to resume for the address.

DELETE /zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/su.description: Deletes an email suppression for the specified zone.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/email/sending.description: Lists email suppressions for the specified account.
Retrieves a single email suppression for the specified account.
Lists every active Email Sending suppression owned by the account, including legacy rows with internal zone memberships.

schema.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `result_info.next_cursor`. It carries the filters that produced it.
A complete address is an exact match; a value ending in `@` matches that username across every domain. Prefix searches may return short intermediate pages while the bounded account scan advances.

read_only.description: Whether clients may mutate this suppression. This is determined by the server and must not be inferred from `reason`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Pass it back as the `cursor` query parameter and continue until it is `null`. A bounded large-account scan may return a short intermediate page.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/email/sending.description: Gets an Email Sending suppression owned by the account.

read_only.description: Whether clients may mutate this suppression. This is determined by the server and must not be inferred from `reason`.

GET /zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/suppr.description: Lists email suppressions for the specified zone.
Retrieves a single email suppression for the specified zone.

PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/email/sendi.description: Updates expiry or advisory note fields without changing legacy internal zone memberships.

expires_at.description: New expiry. Send `null` to make the suppression permanent; omit to leave it unchanged.

note.description: Replacement advisory note. Send an empty string to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

200.description: Returns the updated Email Sending suppression.

read_only.description: Whether clients may mutate this suppression. This is determined by the server and must not be inferred from `reason`.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/email/sendin.description: Creates a new email suppression for the specified account.
Creates an account-wide suppression. If a mutable legacy zone-linked row already exists, it is promoted without changing its identifier.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/email/sendin.summary: Bulk import account Email Sending suppressions
POST /accounts/{account_id}/email/sendin.description: Imports up to 1,000 account-level Email Sending suppressions in one request.

POST /zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/supp.description: Creates a new email suppression for the specified zone.
